name: flow
description: Initiative/Epic/Story/Action flow planner — a library of AI working-style playbooks plus a self-improvement system. Recommends running planned work in parallel across multiple agents (via Claude Code Agent Teams when available), with retrospective-driven context evolution. (Initiative: flow-as-planner)

_recommendedEnv._note: Recommended env for Agent Teams on Claude Code — the richest way to run parallelizable waves as a peer-to-peer team (Claude composes the team dynamically). plugin.json does not apply env directly — set it in .claude/settings.json + restart. Parallel execution is still the goal without it: use parallel subagents (the Task tool) or your tool's own parallel mechanism, and run sequentially only where task dependencies require it. See README.md.
